body.description:
LuxDrive™ N022 MultiBlock Selectable Current LED Boost Driver

Unlock Versatile LED Performance with the LuxDrive™ N022 MultiBlock

Product Overview

The LuxDrive™ MultiBlock DC Selectable Output Boost LED Driver is an innovative LED boost driver designed for applications requiring adjustable output currents. This cutting-edge driver allows users to select and modify the drive current on-the-fly using built-in switches, making it ideal for dynamic lighting environments where different LED currents are needed. Whether you’re designing a complex lighting system or a simple LED application, the N022 MultiBlock provides the flexibility and reliability you need.

Key Features:

  • Selectable Output Current: Choose from seven different output currents (120mA, 240mA, 350mA, 500mA, 700mA, 1000mA, 1200mA) using simple switch settings on the unit.
  • Efficient Power Conversion: With up to 92% efficiency, the N022 ensures minimal energy loss and optimal performance.
  • Wide Input Voltage Range: Operates within a 12-24VDC input range, making it compatible with various power sources.
  • Compact and Durable: Featuring a small form factor (1.57″ x 1.57″ x 0.51″) and rugged design, this driver is built to withstand harsh conditions, with an operating temperature range from -20°C to 80°C.
  • User-Friendly Connectivity: Equipped with 6” 18 gauge wires for easy and secure connections, ensuring hassle-free installation and operation.

Advanced Operation

The N022 MultiBlock is designed for simplicity and ease of use. Adjusting the output current is as easy as flipping a switch, and the unit can be reconfigured during standard operation without the need for power cycling. This flexibility makes it an excellent choice for applications where different lighting intensities are required over time.

Important: To prevent damage, ensure the LED load is connected before applying power to the driver.

Technical Specifications: MultiBlock DC Selectable Output Boost LED Driver

  • Input Voltage: 12-24VDC
  • Output Voltage: Matches input voltage, up to 24VDC
  • Quiescent Current: 180µA (typical)
  • Environmental Tolerance: Operating temperature from -20°C to 80°C, storage temperature from -40°C to 80°C
  • Compliance: RoHS 3 (EU 2015/863) compliant

Applications

The N022 MultiBlock is perfect for a variety of applications, including but not limited to:

  • Architectural lighting
  • Retail display lighting
  • Automotive lighting
  • General purpose LED lighting systems

Ordering Information

The LuxDrive™ N022 MultiBlock is available in multiple configurations to suit your project needs. Refer to the product family part numbers to select the appropriate version for your application.

Explore the Flexibility of LuxDrive™ N022 MultiBlock

With its selectable current settings and robust design, the LuxDrive™ N022 MultiBlock is the ideal solution for versatile LED applications. Whether you need consistent lighting or adaptable output, this driver delivers unmatched performance and reliability.

body.description:
MEAN WELL LPF-60D-24 24V 60W IP67 Dimmable LED Driver

The MEAN WELL LPF-60D-24 is a professional-grade 24V, 60W LED driver designed for reliable operation in architectural, commercial, signage, joinery, display, cabinet, linear LED and outdoor-rated lighting applications.

With a wide 90–305VAC input range, IP67 weather-resistant construction and built-in protection features, this driver is a strong choice where stable 24V LED power, long service life and smart dimming compatibility are required.

24V Output
60W Power
2.5A Max
IP67 Rated
1–10V / PWM / Resistance Dimming
Shelly Compatible*
Important model note: For dimming applications, use the LPF-60D-24 version. The standard LPF-60-24 version is not the correct choice where 0/1–10V control is required.

Why Choose the LPF-60D-24?

Not all 24V LED drivers are equal. The LPF-60D-24 combines the durability of a fully enclosed IP67 driver with the flexibility needed for modern control systems. It is suitable for 24V LED strip, linear lighting, signage modules, display lighting and custom LED assemblies where a dependable, sealed power supply is required.

Stable 24V LED Power

Delivers up to 60W at 24V DC, ideal for medium-power LED strip and module installations.

IP67 Weather Protection

Suitable for dry, damp and protected outdoor installations where dust and moisture resistance are important.

Wide AC Input Range

Accepts 90–305VAC input, making it suitable for many commercial and industrial lighting environments.

Smart Control Ready

The LPF-60D dimming input can be controlled by compatible 1–10V, PWM or resistance-style dimming systems.

Works with Shelly Dimmer 0/1-10V PM Gen3

The Shelly Dimmer 0/1-10V PM Gen3 is designed for controlling compatible 0–10V and 1–10V dimmable drivers. Because the LPF-60D-24 supports 1–10V dimming, the two products are a practical combination for smart 24V LED lighting control.

In a typical installation, the Shelly unit provides the control signal, while the MEAN WELL driver supplies the 24V power to the LED load. This allows smart dimming through the Shelly app, schedules, automation systems or compatible smart home platforms.

Why Use LPF-60D-24 Instead of PWM-60-24?

The MEAN WELL PWM-60-24 is also a 24V 60W LED driver, but it is a different style of product. The PWM series is designed with a PWM output, meaning the driver dims by rapidly switching the LED output on and off while maintaining the output voltage level.

For many LED strips this can work well, but it is not always the preferred choice when the project requires a clean 0/1–10V control relationship with a smart dimming controller such as the Shelly Dimmer 0/1-10V PM Gen3.

The LPF-60D-24 is the better product to present for Shelly 0/1–10V dimming because its dimming input is the key feature being controlled. The Shelly controls the driver; the driver then regulates the LED output.

In simple terms: use LPF-60D-24 when you want Shelly 0/1–10V control of the driver. Use PWM-series drivers only where the application specifically requires MEAN WELL’s PWM-output dimming behaviour.

Ideal Applications

LED Strip Lighting

Suitable for 24V single-colour LED strip installations up to 60W total load.

Architectural Lighting

Ideal for coves, joinery, feature lighting, indirect lighting and display applications.

Commercial Fit-Outs

Useful for retail, hospitality, office, cabinet and signage lighting projects.

Smart Lighting Upgrades

Pairs well with compatible 0/1–10V smart dimming controllers for app and automation control.

Technical Specifications

Specification Details
Manufacturer MEAN WELL
Series LPF-60D Series
Recommended Part Number LPF-60D-24
Output Power 60W
Output Voltage 24V DC nominal
Output Current 2.5A max
Input Voltage Range 90–305VAC
Dimming 1–10V, PWM signal or resistance dimming
Ingress Protection IP67
Protection Features Short circuit, overload, over voltage and over temperature protection
Typical Applications 24V LED strip, linear LED modules, signage, display lighting, architectural lighting and smart dimming projects

Installation Notes

  • Do not exceed 60W total connected LED load.
  • Allow suitable design margin; for continuous use, avoid running LED drivers at 100% load where possible.
  • Use the dimmable LPF-60D-24 model for Shelly 0/1–10V dimming projects.
  • The standard LPF-60-24 should be treated as non-dimmable unless the specific datasheet confirms otherwise.
  • Installation must be carried out by a suitably qualified person in accordance with local electrical regulations.

Datasheet

For full electrical specifications, derating information, safety approvals and wiring details, please refer to the official MEAN WELL datasheet.

The LuxDrive™ A011 FlexBlock™ is a compact, fully potted, dual-mode constant-current LED driver built for real-world installs.
Run it in Buck-Boost mode (default) for LED loads above, below, or equal to supply voltage — or rewire for Boost-Only when you need up to 48 VDC output from as little as 10 VDC.

🔌 Input: 10–32 VDC
⬆️ Boost-Only: up to 48 VDC
🎚️ 0–10 V dimming
⚙️ 350/500/700 mA CC options
🛡️ Fully potted, low profile
Built for: tight spaces, rugged installs, and applications needing fast response (flashing / strobing).

Why FlexBlock is a favourite

  • Buck-Boost flexibility handles LED strings when supply voltage isn’t a perfect match.
  • Boost-Only option for higher LED voltages (up to 48 VDC) from low input sources.
  • Fast current sensing suits flashing/strobing applications.
  • 0–10 V dimming makes brightness control simple and system-friendly.
  • Fully potted + low profile for fast installs in tight enclosures.
Modes at a glance
Buck-Boost (standard): LED load may be above, below, or equal to supply voltage.
Boost-Only: rewired mode; can output up to 48 VDC from as little as 10 VDC.

The LuxDrive™ A009 series BuckBlock™ LED power modules are high output wide range constant current LED drivers for powering high-brightness (HB) LEDs at constant high-output currents. Where standard power supplies deliver a fixed voltage to the output, the BuckBlock is engineered to produce a fixed current. The output voltage will adjust as required to maintain the specified output current with differing forward voltage drops of LEDs. Both dimming controls are independent and can be combined. The driver is also designed to be as reliable as the LEDs it is driving, even at the full operating temperature. Options include an IP67-rated wired version (/W) and a version with built-in reference output voltage (/Vref) to power sensors or for easy analogue dimming.
